title: Listen: How are EU countries performing in reducing their carbon emissions?
lede: EU greenhouse gas emissions continue to fall, and clean technologies are expanding. That’s what the latest EU Climate Action Progress Report and the Carbon Market Report, published on Monday, show. Yet, progress is still needed to achieve the 2030 objectives.
